headline: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon available to developers and consumers
body: Google says Gemini 4 Carbon is available to developers, enterprises, scientists and consumers, and calls it its strongest model. Google says Carbon ranks #1 on CursorBench 4.0, Perplexity’s WANDR and Zapier’s AutomationBench at more than 2X lower cost per task than the next best external model. In the API it costs $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, the same introductory price as Gemini 4 Argon.
note: For banks and payment firms, the API price is the number to watch. The cost-per-task gap is Google's own benchmark claim.

evidence.text: Today, we’re making Gemini 4 Carbon available to developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers.
Carbon is our strongest model with frontier performance in cybersecurity capabilities and long-horizon agentic workflows across complex knowledge work, software engineering, and scientific reasoning.
It ranks #1 on CursorBench 4.0 , Perplexity’s WANDR , and Zapier’s AutomationBench at more than 2X lower cost per task compared to the next best external model.
Gemini 4 Carbon is available via the API in Google AI Studio and Gemini for business for all paying developers and enterprises, at the same introductory price
as Gemini 4 Argon ($2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens).
